items.title: AAE and AAOMR Release Joint Position Statement on the Use of CBCT in Endodontics
items.summary: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE Streamlined Recommendations, Emphasis on Training, and Emerging Technologies Signal Evolution in Imaging Standards CHICAGO and MINNEAPOLIS — The American Association of Endodontists (AAE) and the American Academy of Oral and Maxillofacial Radiology (AAOMR) have released an updated joint position statement titled “Use of Cone-Beam Computed Tomography in Endodontics 2025 Update.” This important…
